{{Top|leg}}
'''Margrave''' was the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] title of the hereditary [[Monarchy/Legends|monarch]] of [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]]. The Margrave was always a male, who lived as a nomadic hunter just as other [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] males did. His only distinction was that it was a great honor to be invited to pitch a tent with his camp.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

The female population was ruled by either the Margrave's mate, or his closest female relative,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> such as a [[Margrave-sister]].<ref name="Missions 8">''[[Star Wars Missions 8: Togorian Trap]]''</ref> She lived in the planetary capital, [[Caross]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], the Margrave invited [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to live on Togoria permanently, to thank him for helping [[Muuurgh]] and his mate [[Mrrov]]. This was an honor given to few non-Togorians.<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title of [[Wikipedia:Margrave|Margrave]] was used as a rank of peerage in parts of continental Europe, especially in the former [[Wikipedia:Holy Roman Empire|Holy Roman Empire]]. Margraves ranked above a [[Count/Legends|Count]], but below a [[Duke/Legends|Duke]].
